chain_words.nuance: to suggest a claim without stating it openly
to put forward a claim as a possibility
to give reasons in support of a claim
to keep defending a position against objection
to state a claim firmly, leaving no room for doubt

explanation: These words all describe putting forward a legal claim, from an implied suggestion to a firm and unqualified assertion.

usage_notes.difference: 'Argue' means giving reasons to support a claim; 'assert' means stating a claim firmly, sometimes without offering reasons.
